verdict.rationale: The only on-point evidence is a single line saying LegalOS keeps "case visibility" within one team, plus mentions of a guided intake flow and a "structured workflow" for organizing materials. These imply some client-facing tooling, but none of them documents a portal or dashboard showing case status and next steps. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented client portal or dashboard, case status tracking, next-step or task display, screenshots or product docs of the interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
